ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white areas dominate the central interior of both lobes. Solid black pigmentation is localized at the leading edges and the central notch region. High-frequency black speckling (mottling) is distributed across the white regions, increasing in density toward the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a narrow vertex dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits frequent low-amplitude serrations; high-amplitude, irregular pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips due to epibiont attachment.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a broad convex curvature, terminating in sharp, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, localized clusters of high-contrast, circular yellowish-white features (barnacles) are present at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, including one prominent vertical-oblique mark.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy epibiont load (barnacles) on the lateral tips; visible dark linear scarring on the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive and dense 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern across the primary white fields of both lobes.
